source.citation: "Chicago in 1820." — hand-coloured lithograph, a bird's-eye view from over the lake, lettered "J. Gemmell lith. 157 Lake St. Chicago".
what_it_does_not_supply: the house in 1812: it claims 1820 and was drawn decades later
any detail of the house: at about 40 px it shows a gabled block and no openings, stacks or piazza
colour: the colouring was added later and is not evidence
what_it_supplies: the house's place: on the north bank east of the forks, across the river from the fort, end-on to the lake
a fenced green on the house's river side with two poplars at its west end, and trees behind it
